schema.onePerFile: Each section can have only one {% schema %} tag, it must contain only valid JSON, and it can't sit inside another Liquid tag.
schema.uniqueSettingIds: Setting IDs must be unique within a section, and within each block.
schema.uniqueBlocks: Block names and types must be unique within a section.
schema.presets: Presets make the section show up in the theme editor's Add section picker.
schema.enabledOnOrDisabledOn: Use only one of enabled_on or disabled_on.

settings.range: min, max and default are required numbers (not strings); step is optional, default 1.
settings.richtext:

settings.inline_richtext:

settings.select: options is required: an array of value and label.
settings.checkbox: Returns a boolean; false if no default.
settings.color: Returns a color; blank if no default.

css.stylesheet: Liquid isn't rendered inside {% stylesheet %} tags.
css.style: {% style %} outputs a <style data-shopify> tag; color settings used inside it update live in the theme editor.

pasteSteps: Before you edit code, duplicate your theme as a backup: Online Store, then the ... button next to your theme, then Duplicate.
From your Shopify admin, go to Online Store, click the ... (horizontal menu) button next to your current theme, then Edit code.
In the file list, find the sections folder. Right-click it and choose New file. (Older code editors show an Add a new section link under Sections instead.)
Type the file name exactly as given, like sk-trust-bar.liquid, and press Enter.
Select everything in the new file, delete it, paste the whole section file, and click Save.
Go back to Online Store, click Edit theme (some admins say Customize), pick the page from the drop-down at the top (Home page, or Products for a product page).
In the sidebar click Add section, search for the section name, add it, then change the text, colors and images on the right. Click Save.
themeNeed: The sections need an Online Store 2.0 theme: one where you can click Add section on product pages, not only on the home page.
